3. And the Category grid has record "101" owned by "FMO_ADMIN"
4. And the baseline fixture data defines "Category Label" as "case-060"
5. And Category record "101" is inactive when this browser loads its grid
7. When Admin A clicks the button labeled "Verify" in the Category grid row with "Record Id" "101"
